claim: From Kyoto, Kintetsu express is 45 min / 760 yen and limited express 35 min / 1,280 yen, while JR Miyakoji rapid is 45 min / 720 yen.
quote: Express Train: 45 minutes, 760 yen; Limited Express: 35 minutes, 1,280 yen ... JR Miyakoji Rapid Service: 45 minutes, 720 yen

claim: Kintetsu Nara Station is an underground station a few steps from Kofukuji and Nara Park, while JR Nara station is a 15-20 minute walk west of the park; Kyoto JR is 720 yen and Kintetsu 760-1,280 yen.
quote: an underground station just a few steps from Kofukuji and Nara Park ... the JR station is a 15-20 minute walk west of Kofukuji and the park

claim: From Osaka-Namba, Kintetsu Rapid Express is about 39 min / 680 yen and limited express 34 min / 1,200 yen; JR Yamatoji rapid from Osaka Station is 45 min / 840 yen and covered by the JR Pass.
quote: Rapid Express train takes 39 minutes and costs 680 yen ... Limited Express services take 34 minutes and cost 1,200 yen ... Yamatoji rapid ... one-way trip takes 45 minutes, costs 840 yen

claim: A pack of 10 shika senbei deer crackers costs 200 yen and a portion of the proceeds goes to activities to protect the park's deer.
quote: A pack of 10 deer biscuits costs 200 yen ... A portion of the proceeds goes to activities to protect the park's deer.

claim: Nara deer bowing is learned behaviour from being rewarded with crackers; after feeding, raise empty hands to signal no more food, and several dozen tourist injuries occur each year mostly from petting or provoking deer.
quote: they have learned that they get shika senbei upon bowing their heads ... Several dozen tourist injuries are reported each year, mainly due to petting or provoking the deer.

claim: During the autumn rut (stags in heat Sept-Oct), 35 people were injured at Nara park in September 2024 (a 7-fold year-on-year rise), 10 needing hospitalization, mostly puncture wounds to the thigh.
quote: 35 people were injured in September 2024 ... 10 of those injured required hospitalization ... From September to October each year, the stags are in heat and become more aggressive

claim: Todaiji's Great Buddha Hall opens 7:30-17:30 (Apr-Oct) and 8:00-17:00 (Nov-Mar); adult admission is 800 yen, with a 1,200 yen combined hall+museum ticket.
quote: April - October: 7:30 - 17:30; November - March: 8:00 - 17:00 ... Adult 800 ... combined ticket ... Adult: 1,200

claim: Kofukuji halls and museum are open 9:00-17:00 (entry until 16:45) with grounds open 24 hours; individual halls cost 500 yen each, the National Treasure Museum 900 yen, or 1,600 yen combined.
quote: 9:00 to 17:00 (entry until 16:45) ... 900 yen (National Treasure Museum) 500 yen (Central Golden Hall) 500 yen (Eastern Golden Hall) 1600 yen (all three)

claim: Kasuga Taisha main sanctuary worship hours are 6:30-17:30 (Mar-Oct) and 7:00-17:00 (Nov-Feb), with a free offering hall and a paid inner area for a closer view.
quote: General Worship of Main Sanctuary: March - October 6:30 - 17:30, November - February 7:00 - 17:00

claim: A half-day Nara visit (~4-5 hours incl. train) covers the deer and Todaiji; a full day adds Kasuga Taisha, Naramachi and Isuien, with the forested Todaiji-to-Kasuga walk taking about 20 minutes.
quote: a comfortable half-day trip takes 4-5 hours including train travel ... The path from Todaiji east through the forest to Kasuga Taisha takes 20 minutes on foot
